description: Query the current multichain balance and NFT inventory, then append one compact profile-local observation for historical tracking. Stores public-address fingerprint, coverage, breakdown, and known priced value only; no keys, signatures, executable payloads, or raw NFT metadata. Returns the live balance, NFT result, and recorded snapshot.

includeNfts.description: Include provider-estimated NFT value. Default true.

tokensByChain.description: Caller-supplied ERC-20 addresses by chain id; read through generic EVM RPC. Testnet balances are excluded from USD totals.

name: portfolio_snapshot
